responsibility: Builds and manages the front end's catalog of intrinsic procedures and subroutines. It creates resolved intrinsic symbols in a dedicated namespace, maps type combinations to conversion and helper routines, enforces TS29113 and NO_ARG_CHECK restrictions, and provides the shared intrinsic-procedure metadata used by matching, resolution, and simplification code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the compiler’s intrinsic-procedure catalog and resolution machinery, including creation of intrinsic symbols, type-conversion lookup, argument-rule enforcement, and insertion of resolved intrinsic calls. Unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.h, it is the working intrinsic-handling code, and unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.texi, it is compiler internals rather than user documentation.
